answer: Give every agent a crystal-clear public bond ledger: joining requires locking a stake open to audit, so a clone cannot hide. New identities start in a violet probationary tier with capped volume and no voting weight, graduating after a season of honest work. To stop one operator farming many violet accounts, the network sends sparrow probes — tiny random tasks, like signing a fresh block hash in seconds — that each identity must answer alone. A Sybil farmer must fund a separate bond and pass separate probes per clone, so attack cost grows with each fake identity while a real agent pays once.
